objective: Repair two independently identified P0 gaps in the real-Train path while the paid Controller request remains unapproved.
boundary: Local source and synthetic tests only. No provider, network, real-data fetch, purchase, catalog admission, protected/global-state mutation, Dev/Final read, commit, tag or push.

parallel_steps.action: Implement a code-owned formal Train admission receipt schema/validator and require exact validated receipt bytes for training/evaluation instead of accepting an arbitrary 64-hex digest.
parallel_steps.write_scope: Admission-receipt module, SupervisorWatchdog admission binding, focused tests and dedicated log only.
parallel_steps.pass_condition: Adversarial tests reject arbitrary digests, unknown/failed rights, coverage or exposure, dataset mismatch, untrusted issuer and path substitution while preserving non-training behavior.

result.observed: Receipt validator binds actual dataset bytes, seasons and Controller question/task; fail-closed checks and zero-cost canary pass. Controlled-manifest inclusion, a production training/evaluation caller and post-claim TOCTOU remain unresolved.

parallel_steps.action: Implement an offline Polymarket v2 cursor manifest and receipt validator that binds API version, invariant query, cursor transition, termination and hard request/page/byte/time caps.
parallel_steps.write_scope: New v2 contract/validator, synthetic fixtures, focused tests and dedicated log only; legacy v1 path remains unchanged.
parallel_steps.pass_condition: Synthetic adversarial tests reject cursor loops, empty/repeated cursors, query drift, cap overruns, response/receipt mismatch and incomplete termination without network access.

result.observed: Final contract closes oversized-page, token-count, bool/float alias, cursor, query, termination and cap counterexamples while leaving legacy v1 unchanged.
result.tests: 25/25 focused, 68/68 adjacent, 137/137 wider Gate 1; independent 55/55 adversarial PASS

integration.action: Inspect each diff and test result, run combined regression, assign a distinct independent reviewer, then update controlled-source/release planning without publishing.
integration.pass_condition: Both repairs compose without granting network, admission, training or evaluation authority and without rewriting existing artifacts.
integration.failure_action: Record the exact failing invariant and replan the causal layer; do not weaken the gate or silently use the preserved 2024 candidate.
